legend: Busy Beaver is causing chaos at the farmers' market again! This time, he is starting a food fight among the stalls.

The stalls are numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to N$$$N$$$ and are connected by N−1$$$N-1$$$ roads, forming a tree. In other words, it is possible to travel from any stall to any other stall by following the roads, and there is exactly one simple path between any two stalls.
Busy Beaver assigns each stall to either Team Potato or Team Tomato as follows:

He starts at stall 1$$$1$$$, travels along the roads, visits every stall, and finally returns to stall 1$$$1$$$. Among all such routes, he chooses one with the minimum possible total number of roads traversed.
Stall 1$$$1$$$ is assigned to Team Potato.

Whenever Busy Beaver visits a stall for the first time (other than stall 1$$$1$$$), he immediately assigns it to one of the two teams. To keep the fight fair, he alternates the team assignment each time he assigns a new stall. That is, if the most recently assigned stall was assigned to Team Potato, then the next newly visited stall must be assigned to Team Tomato, and vice versa.

Your task is to count the number of possible team assignments. Note that different minimum-length routes may produce the same final assignment; such assignments should be counted only once. Since the answer may be enormous, output it modulo 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$.
input: The first line contains a single integer T$$$T$$$ (1≤T≤104$$$1 \le T \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains a single integer N$$$N$$$ (2≤N≤105$$$2 \le N \le 10^5$$$).

Each of the next N−1$$$N-1$$$ lines contains two integers u$$$u$$$ and v$$$v$$$ (1≤u,v≤N$$$1 \le u, v \le N$$$, u≠v$$$u \neq v$$$), indicating that there is a road between stalls u$$$u$$$ and v$$$v$$$.
The sum of N$$$N$$$ across all test cases does not exceed 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, output a single integer: the number of possible final team assignments modulo 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$.
There are two subtasks for this problem.
(10$$$10$$$ points): The stalls form a star graph rooted at stall 1$$$1$$$. More specifically, stall 1$$$1$$$ has N−1$$$N-1$$$ roads connected to it.

(20$$$20$$$ points): The stalls form a binary tree rooted at stall 1$$$1$$$. More specifically, stall 1$$$1$$$ has at most 2$$$2$$$ roads connected to it, and every other stall has at most 3$$$3$$$ roads connected to it.
note: Test case 1$$$1$$$ satisfies the second subtask (binary tree).
Test case 2$$$2$$$ satisfies the first subtask (star graph).
Test case 3$$$3$$$ satisfies the second subtask (binary tree).
Test case 4$$$4$$$ satisfies the third subtask (no additional constraints).
In the first test case, one possible team assignment is shown below.
Its total length is 6$$$6$$$, which is the smallest possible for a route that starts at stall 1$$$1$$$, visits every stall, and returns to stall 1$$$1$$$.
The stalls are then assigned in the order in which they are first visited:
Stall 1$$$1$$$ is assigned to Team Potato.
Stall 2$$$2$$$ is assigned to Team Tomato.
Stall 3$$$3$$$ is assigned to Team Potato.
Stall 4$$$4$$$ is assigned to Team Tomato.
The other possible team assignment is obtained by visiting stall 4$$$4$$$ before stall 3$$$3$$$, which swaps their teams. Therefore, the total number of possible team assignments is 2$$$2$$$.

legend.ai: Busy Beaver 又在农贸市场制造混乱了！这一次，他要在各个摊位之间挑起一场食物大战。
摊位从 1$$$1$$$ 到 N$$$N$$$ 编号，并由 N−1$$$N-1$$$ 条道路连接，构成一棵树。换句话说，沿着道路可以从任意一个摊位到达任意另一个摊位，且任意两个摊位之间恰好存在一条简单路径。
Busy Beaver 按如下方式将每个棚位分配给土豆队或番茄队：
他从棚位 1$$$1$$$ 出发，沿着道路行进，访问每个棚位，最后返回棚位 1$$$1$$$。在所有这样的路线中，他选择经过道路总数可能最少的一条。
棚位 1$$$1$$$ 被分配给土豆队。
每当 Busy Beaver 第一次访问某个棚位(棚位 1$$$1$$$ 除外)时，他会立即将其分配给两个队伍中的一个。为了保证比赛公平，每当他分配一个新的棚位时，就交替分配队伍。也就是说，如果最近分配的棚位被分配给了土豆队，那么下一个新访问的棚位必须被分配给番茄队，反之亦然。
你的任务是计算可能的队伍分配方案数量。注意，不同的最短路线可能产生相同的最终分配方案；这种分配方案只应计数一次。由于答案可能非常大，请输出答案对 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$ 取模的结果。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 T$$$T$$$ (1≤T≤104$$$1 \le T \le 10^4$$$)，表示测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 N$$$N$$$(2≤N≤105$$$2 \le N \le 10^5$$$)。
接下来的 N−1$$$N-1$$$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 u$$$u$$$ 和 v$$$v$$$(1≤u,v≤N$$$1 \le u, v \le N$$$，u≠v$$$u \neq v$$$)，表示摊位 u$$$u$$$ 和 v$$$v$$$ 之间有一条道路。
所有测试用例中 N$$$N$$$ 的总和不超过 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数：可能的最终队伍分配数量对 109+7$$$10^9+7$$$ 取模的结果。
(10$$$10$$$ 分)：这些摊位构成一棵以摊位 1$$$1$$$ 为根的星形图。更具体地说，摊位 1$$$1$$$ 与 N−1$$$N-1$$$ 条道路相连。
(20$$$20$$$ 分)：这些牛棚构成一棵以牛棚 1$$$1$$$ 为根的二叉树。更具体地说，牛棚 1$$$1$$$ 至多连接 2$$$2$$$ 条道路，而其他每个牛棚至多连接 3$$$3$$$ 条道路。

note.ai: 样例包含 4$$$4$$$ 个测试用例：
测试用例 1$$$1$$$ 满足第二个子任务(二叉树)。
测试用例 2$$$2$$$ 满足第一个子任务(星形图)。
测试用例 3$$$3$$$ 满足第二个子任务(二叉树)。
测试用例 4$$$4$$$ 满足第三个子任务(没有额外约束)。
第一个测试用例的一种可行组队方案如下所示。
路线总长度为 6$$$6$$$，这是从摊位 1$$$1$$$ 出发、访问每个摊位并返回摊位 1$$$1$$$ 的路线的可能最小长度。
然后按照摊位首次被访问的顺序为它们分配：
摊位 1$$$1$$$ 分配给 Potato 队。
摊位 2$$$2$$$ 分配给 Tomato 队。
摊位 3$$$3$$$ 分配给 Potato 队。
摊位 4$$$4$$$ 分配给 Tomato 队。
另一种可能的队伍分配方式是先访问摊位 4$$$4$$$，再访问摊位 3$$$3$$$，这会交换它们所属的队伍。因此，可能的队伍分配方式总数为 2$$$2$$$。
